c1.note: Oracle's own release gives record FY2026 revenue of $67.4B, up 17% USD. It is the latest full-year figure.

c3.note: The release says FY2026 revenue was up 17% in USD.

c4.note: The release says FY2026 revenue was up 16% in constant currency.

c5.note: FY2025 revenue of about $57.4B is confirmed by the narrative. The exact $57,399M matches my knowledge of Oracle's FY2025 10-K.

c6.note: FY2025 growth of about 8% is consistent with $57,399M against $52,961M, and with my knowledge of Oracle's FY2025 results.

c7.note: FY2024 revenue of $52,961M matches my knowledge of Oracle's FY2024 10-K. The passages show only the cloud and geographic breakdowns.

c8.note: The 10-K covers the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026, so Oracle's fiscal year ends May 31.

c9.note: The release gives record FY2026 cloud revenue of $34.0B, up 39%.

c10.note: The release gives FY2026 IaaS revenue of $18.1B, up 77% USD.

c11.note: The release gives FY2026 SaaS revenue of $15.9B, up 11% USD.

c12.note: The release gives Q4 FY2026 revenue of $19.2B, up 21%.

c13.note: The release is dated June 10, 2026 and says its information is current as of that date.

c14.note: This is a forecast. Oracle has reported its Q4 and full-year results in June each year (FY2025 10-K filed June 18, 2025; FY2026 results June 10, 2026). No passage states the FY2027 date.

c15.note: The release says 'we confirm our prior revenue guidance of $90 billion total revenue' for FY2027.

c16.note: The FY2026 10-K covers the year ended May 31, 2026. FY2027 ends May 2027, so FY2026 is the latest completed fiscal year.

c17.note: Oracle's release states fiscal year 2026 total revenues were a record $67.4B. That is completed fiscal-year revenue, not TTM and not a forecast.

c18.note: The 10-K reports consolidated total revenues in USD, with a geographic breakdown showing U.S. revenue of $39.8B.

c19.note: Oracle's SEC filings show FY2026 (ended May 31, 2026) total revenues of $67,357M, up 17%. I could not inspect a Fiscal.ai page that links to this figure, so the claim about Fiscal.ai's record is not directly confirmed. The figure itself is correct and current.

c4.note: Oracle's Q4 FY26 earnings release (June 10, 2026) says FY2026 total revenues were a record $67.4B, up 17% in USD and up 16% in constant currency. This is the latest full fiscal year (ended May 31, 2026).
